name: 美柚
description: fmz200/wool_scripts · 某些APP要清除缓存或者重新安装拦截广告才会生效！
text:
#!name=美柚
#!desc=fmz200/wool_scripts · 某些APP要清除缓存或者重新安装拦截广告才会生效！
#!author=奶思

[MITM]
hostname = x.seeyouyima.com, axxd.xmseeyouyima.com, config-service.seeyouyima.com

[Rewrite]
request if ${url} ~= /^http:\/\/x\.seeyouyima\.com\/adx\/staticstics\?/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/axxd\.xmseeyouyima\.com\/ad\//i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/axxd\.xmseeyouyima\.com\/ad_statistics\?/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/axxd\.xmseeyouyima\.com\/v1\/getad\?/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/axxd\.xmseeyouyima\.com\/pregetad\?/i then reject(404)

[Script]
response if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/config-service\.seeyouyima\.com\/api\/configs\/batch\?/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/main/Scripts/meiyou/meiyou_ads.js") with enable=${meiyou_enable}, tag="美柚App净化", timeout=60, requires_body=true
response if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/config-service\.seeyouyima\.com\/api\/configs\?/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/main/Scripts/meiyou/meiyou_ads.js") with enable=${meiyou_enable}, tag="美柚App净化", timeout=60, requires_body=true
